pages.text: [#](53341a)Drop of Luck sounds fanciful until a rite or brew refuses to work without it. In the older craft it belonged to the **Witch's Cauldron**, not the kettle — a harsher working that curdles good hedge powders into something stranger.[#]()
pages.title: Drop of Luck

pages.text: [#](53341a)It sits at the edge between ordinary mutation and the more capricious parts of the craft.[#]()

[#](53341a)Heat and fill a Witch's Cauldron, keep an altar near, drop in a **Mandrake Root**, **Nether Wart**, **Tear of the Goddess**, and **Refined Evil**, then use **Mutandis Extremis** on the cauldron.[#]()
[#](53341a)The powder is spent, the altar pays, and a single Drop of Luck condenses from the bowl.[#]()
